synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO defines Total Demand as the forecast demand at the Regional Reference Node (RRN) used as the launch point for central dispatch.

document_statements.quote: Total Demand is the forecast demand at the Regional Reference Node (RRN) that is met by local generation from scheduled and semi-scheduled generating units and scheduled BDUs plus interconnector imports, excluding the local demand of scheduled loads and scheduled BDUs and the allocated interconnector losses, but including the demand met by Wholesale Demand Response.

document_statements.paraphrase: Total Demand is calculated by the NEM Dispatch Engine (NEMDE) and is used as the launch point for the central dispatch process which performs the regional price calculations in Dispatch, Pre-dispatch and five-minute pre-dispatch, and determines dispatch targets for generating units.

document_statements.quote: The ResDemand is adjusted to remove the allocated interconnector losses to determine the Total Demand at the Regional Reference Node (RRN).
Allocated Interconnector Losses = Sum (MWLosses x FromRegionLossShare A) Over all Interconnectors connected to the region

document_statements.paraphrase: In Dispatch and the first interval of five-minute pre-dispatch, Total Demand is computed from SCADA actuals by summing scheduled and semi-scheduled generation plus net actual interconnector flow, minus actual demand of regional scheduled loads and estimated actual allocated interconnector losses, plus Wholesale Demand Response, DemandForecast and AggregateDispatchError.
